description: The cache of loaded modules by name. A module body runs only on its first import; later imports return the cached object.
Imports `x`, then binds a new name `y` to the object `x.y` referenced at that moment. It is not a live binding.
The import name of a module, or `"__main__"` for the file Python was started with.
A module already in `sys.modules` whose body is still running, which is what a circular import sees.
Work done by a module's top level, such as registering handlers, which runs once per process on first import.
